rules.description: Rule code (or a prefix ending in .*) -> off / error / warning / info / hint, or [severity, { options }].

karel.compiledFile.description: a compiled .pc saved under a .kl name (check, default info)

karel.endName.description: END name does not match the PROGRAM or ROUTINE (check, default error)

karel.environment.description: a built-in whose %ENVIRONMENT group is not in the header (check, default warning)

karel.fileName.description: the program name differs from the file name (check, default warning)

karel.identLength.description: a name longer than the core version allows (check, default warning)

karel.includeMissing.description: an %INCLUDE file that is not there (Check Before Compile) (check, default error)

karel.lint.argCount.description: a routine called with the wrong number of arguments (check, default error)

karel.lint.assignConst.description: an assignment to a constant (check, default error)

karel.lint.commentLength.description: %COMMENT longer than the controller keeps (check, default warning)

karel.lint.cStyle.description: C-style syntax that is not KAREL (check, default error)

karel.lint.declAfterBegin.description: a declaration after BEGIN (check, default error)

karel.lint.directivePlacement.description: a directive inside a body or after the declarations (check, default error)

karel.lint.duplicate.description: a name declared twice (check, default error)

karel.lint.elseif.description: ELSEIF, which KAREL does not have (check, default error)

karel.lint.integerRange.description: an INTEGER literal out of range (check, default error)

karel.lint.lockGroup.description: MOVE with %NOLOCKGROUP, or %NOLOCKGROUP missing from a program that does not move (check, default error)

karel.lint.noBegin.description: a program or routine with no BEGIN (check, default error)

karel.lint.reservedName.description: a reserved word used as a name (check, default error)

karel.lint.returnValue.description: RETURN without a value in a function, or with one in a procedure (check, default error)

karel.lint.stringLength.description: a string literal or STRING[n] longer than KAREL holds (check, default error)

karel.style.keywordCase.description: a keyword not written in upper case (style, default off)

karel.style.lineLength.description: a line longer than max characters (style, default off)

karel.style.programComment.description: the program has no %COMMENT (style, default hint)

karel.style.routineLength.description: a routine or main body longer than max lines (style, default off)

karel.style.todo.description: TODO / FIXME / XXX left in a comment (style, default hint)

karel.unbalanced.description: blocks not closed or closed by the wrong word (check, default error)

karel.undeclared.description: a name used but never declared (ktrans does not catch this) (check, default warning)

karel.unused.description: a variable, constant or routine nothing uses (check, default hint)

rapid.badDeclaration.description: a declaration the parser could not read (check, default warning)

rapid.duplicateName.description: two routines/data/records with one name in a module, or a local that repeats a parameter (check, default error)

rapid.misplaced.description: ELSE outside IF, CASE outside TEST, a handler inside a block (check, default error)

rapid.missingSemicolon.description: a statement without its ";" (check, default warning)

rapid.style.breakInstruction.description: a BREAK (debug stop) left in the program (style, default info)

rapid.style.dataNaming.description: data whose name does not start with its type's prefix (options: type -> prefix) (style, default off)

rapid.style.inlineTarget.description: a move to an inline target (*) instead of a named robtarget (style, default off)

rapid.style.keywordCase.description: a RAPID keyword not written in upper case (style, default off)

rapid.style.lineLength.description: a line longer than max characters (style, default off)

rapid.style.routineLength.description: a routine longer than max lines (style, default off)

rapid.style.todo.description: TODO / FIXME / XXX left in a comment (style, default hint)

rapid.style.unusedLocalData.description: LOCAL module data nothing in its module uses (style, default hint)

rapid.style.waitTimeout.description: WaitDI/WaitDO/WaitUntil/... with no \MaxTime waits forever if the condition never comes (style, default hint)

rapid.syntax.description: a statement the parser could not read (check, default warning)

rapid.unclosedBlock.description: IF/FOR/WHILE/TEST/PROC/... with no END word (check, default error)

rapid.undefinedLabel.description: GOTO to a label the routine does not have (check, default error)

rapid.unknownRoutine.description: a call to a routine the task does not declare and RAPID does not have (check, default warning)

rapid.unmatchedEnd.description: an END word with nothing open to close (check, default error)

rapid.unusedLocalRoutine.description: a LOCAL routine nothing in its module names (check, default hint)

tp.block.description: IF/FOR blocks that are not closed or closed by the wrong word (check, default error)

tp.bracketShape.description: bracket arguments the parser had to guess at (check, default info)

tp.cntBeforeOperation.description: a CNT move right before an operation that has to happen at the point (check, default warning)

tp.commentInconsistent.description: one register or I/O commented two ways in one program (check, default warning)

tp.commentLength.description: a comment line longer than the controller keeps (check, default warning)

tp.commentMismatch.description: an inline comment that differs from the controller's (editor only) (check, default info)

tp.crossReference.description: what the robot's other programs do with a register or I/O (editor only) (check, default info)

tp.doubleTerminator.description: more than one ";" at the end of a line (check, default error)

tp.duplicateLabel.description: a LBL[n] defined twice (check, default error)

tp.duplicatePosition.description: two points at (nearly) the same place in one user frame (check, default hint)

tp.extendedCommentWidth.description: an extended comment line wider than the pendant writes (check, default warning)

tp.header.description: /PROG, /MN and /END are where the controller expects them (check, default error)

tp.integerAxisValue.description: a position value written as an integer (check, default warning)

tp.lineCount.description: LINE_COUNT does not match the program (check, default warning)

tp.lineSequence.description: line numbers out of sequence or missing (check, default warning)

tp.missingProgram.description: a CALL or macro to a program that is not there (check, default info)

tp.missingTerminator.description: a line without its " ;" (check, default warning)

tp.payload.description: PAYLOAD[n] that does not exist or was never set up (editor only) (check, default warning)

tp.speed.description: speeds and CNT values out of range (check, default error)

tp.style.fixedWait.description: a fixed time WAIT (n sec) instead of waiting for a condition (style, default off)

tp.style.frameSelect.description: a program that moves the robot without selecting UFRAME_NUM and UTOOL_NUM first (style, default off)

tp.style.maxSpeed.description: motion faster than the plant limit (style, default off)

tp.style.programComment.description: the program has no COMMENT in /ATTR (style, default hint)

tp.style.programLength.description: a program longer than max lines (style, default off)

tp.style.programName.description: the program name does not match the plant naming pattern (style, default off)

tp.style.todo.description: TODO / FIXME / XXX left in a comment (style, default hint)

tp.style.uncommentedIo.description: I/O used without a comment in brackets (style, default off)

tp.style.waitTimeout.description: a WAIT on a condition with no TIMEOUT,LBL[...] waits forever if the signal never comes (style, default hint)

tp.undefinedLabel.description: a JMP to a label the program does not have (check, default error)

tp.undefinedPosition.description: a P[n] with no data in /POS, or data given twice (check, default error)

tp.unknownMacro.description: a macro not in the controller's macro table (editor only) (check, default info)

tp.untaughtPosition.description: a P[n] whose /POS block holds no position (check, default warning)

tp.unusedLabel.description: a label nothing jumps to (check, default hint)

tp.unusedPosition.description: position data no instruction uses (check, default hint)

ignore.description: Glob patterns of files not to lint, relative to this file. A pattern without / matches the file name anywhere.
